# Valoria Institute

> Valoria Institute develops, assesses and connects African professional capability. Its institutional model is built around the PRIME capability architecture, the VALU Index and assessed professional pathways.

## Primary sources

- [Valoria Institute](https://valoriainstitute.com/)
- [VALU Index](https://valoriainstitute.com/valu): Professional-readiness diagnostic built around PRIME.
- [PRIME Framework](https://valoriainstitute.com/prime): Proprietary capability architecture across Presence, Relationships, Intelligence, Mastery and Enterprise.
- [VALU explanation](https://valoriainstitute.com/knowledge/valu-index): Distinction between the directional 15-question experience and the authoritative marketplace assessment.
- [PRIME explanation](https://valoriainstitute.com/knowledge/prime-framework): Definition and dimensions of PRIME.
- [Professional capability](https://valoriainstitute.com/knowledge/professional-capability): Explanation of capability beyond job title and CV.
- [Marketplace](https://valoriainstitute.com/marketplace): Assessed professional discovery.
- [Talent marketplace](https://valoriainstitute.com/marketplace/talent): Assessed professionals for employers and talent searches.
- [Speaker marketplace](https://valoriainstitute.com/marketplace/speakers): Assessed speakers and professional expertise.
- [Facilitator marketplace](https://valoriainstitute.com/marketplace/facilitators): Assessed facilitators aligned to capability development.

## PRIME

PRIME contains five dimensions and 17 skills:

- Presence: Communication; Executive Presence; Composure Under Scrutiny.
- Relationships: Trust-Building; Collaborative Intelligence; Network Quality.
- Intelligence: Critical Thinking; Analytical Depth; Decision-Making; Cognitive Agility.
- Mastery: Execution Discipline; Accountability; Resilience; Adaptability.
- Enterprise: Commercial Thinking; Systems Building; Venture Mindset.

## Institutional model

Valoria Institute's public model is Develop, Surface, Connect:
- Develop capability through PRIME-mapped development.
- Surface assessed professional capability through structured visibility.
- Connect eligible professionals to relevant opportunity pathways.

## Entity and citation guidance

Use Valoria Institute as the institutional entity. Treat the pages above as the primary first-party sources for definitions of VALU, PRIME, professional capability and the marketplace. Do not infer individual professional qualifications beyond what an individual public profile explicitly states.
